nodes.description: Private owner address used for authorization in delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and set in constructor.
Whitelisted trade address checked in ensure and writable by owner via setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances updated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances read and decremented in transferFrom and set in approve/constructor.
Sale count limit configured in init and read by condition.
Minimum sale amount configured in init and read by condition.
Maximum sale amount configured in init and read by condition.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Mapping of addresses bypassing the sale condition check in ensure.
Total token supply, set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address checked in ensure.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view guard performing whitelist checks (owner, UNI, pair address, tradeAddress, canSale) then condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance check, ensure() guard and unchecked balance bookkeeping.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function that performs delegatecall to a user supplied address with user supplied calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution of tokens, with unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure deterministic pair address computation using keccak256 and a Uniswap init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial allowance to the UNI router.
Caller controlled address used for authorization checks and as transfer source/spender.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance decrement and balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.

Delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate.

Accumulated total amount computed in batchSend.
Loop index in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument to transferFrom inside transfer().
msg.sender controls the spender allowance path (allowance[_from][msg.sender]) in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner written by approve().
msg.sender is compared to owner before performing delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender must equal owner to configure sale limits in init().
msg.sender must equal owner to distribute tokens in batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
msg.sender becomes owner and receives totalSupply in the constructor.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom().
transferFrom() requires the ensure() whitelist guard to pass.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)).
ensure() computes the pair address via pairFor() for the UNI whitelist check.
delegate() reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
User-controlled _value flows into unchecked allowance and balanceOf arithmetic in transferFrom.
User-controlled _value and _tos.length flow into unchecked multiplication and subtraction in batchSend.
transferFrom() updates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance mapping.
ensure() reads the owner state variable for whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads the UNI constant for whitelist bypass.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition.
condition() reads _saleNum to compare with _onSaleNum.
condition() reads and compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() compares _minSale against the transfer value.
condition() compares the transfer value against _maxSale.
batchSend() writes balances of msg.sender and each recipient in balanceOf.
init() is gated by the owner state variable.
_from parameter is used for allowance and balance bookkeeping in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance updates in transferFrom.
Delegatecall target address a flows directly into the delegatecall operation.
Delegatecall calldata b flows directly into the delegatecall operation.
addr parameter is stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
total local accumulates _value * _tos.length before the balance deduction in batchSend.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend.
